message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll typically find on hand when making traditional Italian lasagna:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | About 9–12 sheets per layer |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef or pork (or a mix) | 1 lb (≈450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | ½ cup |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Canned crushed tomatoes or passata | 28 oz (800 ml) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1–2 tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | To taste |
| | Optional herbs (basil, oregano, thyme) | A pinch each |
| | Red wine (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Cheese Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15–20 oz (425–570 g) |
| | Mozzarella cheese, shredded | 8–10 oz (225–280 g) |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated | ½–¾ cup |
| | Egg (for binding ricotta mixture) | 1 egg |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 1 tsp |
| | Nutmeg (freshly ground) | Pinch |
| **Béchamel Sauce** *(if using)* | Butter | 4 tbsp |
| | All-purpose flour | ⅓ cup |
| | Milk | 4 cups |
| | Salt & white pepper | To taste |
| | Nutmeg | Pinch |

### Quick Tips:
* If you’re short on time, skip béchamel—just use extra mozzarella and/or a splash of milk with your meat sauce.
* For a vegetarian version, replace the meat with sautéed mushrooms, spinach, zucchini, or lentils.
* Preheat the oven at 375°F (190°C); bake covered for ~25 minutes, then uncovered for another 15–20 minutes until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy building layers of pasta, savory sauce, creamy cheeses, and optional béchamel into a hearty lasagna!
